sources.note: Hand-written example policy for this demo. Not a real company's policy.

t-1.ref: Example travel and expenses policy, Section 1. Purpose
t-1.label: Section 1. Purpose
t-1.text: The company reimburses reasonable costs that an employee incurs wholly and necessarily for company business. Costs of a personal nature are not reimbursed.

t-2.ref: Example travel and expenses policy, Section 2. Air and rail travel
t-2.label: Section 2. Air and rail travel
t-2.text: Book economy class for flights under six hours and standard class for rail. Premium economy is allowed on flights of six hours or more with written manager approval. Upgrades bought for comfort or personal preference are not reimbursed.

t-3.ref: Example travel and expenses policy, Section 3. Hotels
t-3.label: Section 3. Hotels
t-3.text: The company pays for a standard room up to £150 per night in London and up to £110 per night elsewhere in the UK. Minibar items, in-room films, spa and gym charges are not reimbursed.

t-4.ref: Example travel and expenses policy, Section 4. Meals while travelling
t-4.label: Section 4. Meals while travelling
t-4.text: When an employee travels overnight on business, meals are reimbursed up to £35 per day. Alcohol is not reimbursed. Meals with colleagues only, with no client present, are treated as personal unless a director approves them in advance.

t-5.ref: Example travel and expenses policy, Section 5. Client entertainment
t-5.label: Section 5. Client entertainment
t-5.text: Client meals are reimbursed up to £60 per person when the claim names the client attendees and states the business purpose. Entertainment over £500 needs approval before the event.

t-6.ref: Example travel and expenses policy, Section 6. Mileage and local travel
t-6.label: Section 6. Mileage and local travel
t-6.text: Use of a private car on company business is paid at 45p per mile. Travel between home and the employee's usual place of work is commuting and is not reimbursed. Taxis are reimbursed when public transport is not practical or when carrying equipment.

t-7.ref: Example travel and expenses policy, Section 7. Costs never reimbursed
t-7.label: Section 7. Costs never reimbursed
t-7.text: The company does not reimburse fines or penalties of any kind, including parking and speeding fines; personal travel insurance, because the company policy covers business trips; personal clothing, toiletries or luggage; or tips above 10% of the bill.
